about_the_game:
D.E.L.I.V.E.R.E.R.S. is a fast-paced multiplayer platformer where you and your fruity friends fight your way up in a deadly vertical world. Loot and make some credits. Pay tribute to the overlord to live or defy him to save the world.

Climb, sneak, and smash your way through traps, enemies, and secrets in chaotic co-op action.

Explore bizarre biomes and vertical dungeons.

Loot & Sell everything you can carry.

Upgrade your gear and evolve your juicy character.

Overthrow the overlord or pay your monthly nonsense tax to avoid spontaneous combustion!

Are you sweet enough to survive? Or will you rot trying?

Always remember this. You and your fruit gang are D.E.L.I.V.E.R.E.R.S.! A fearless crew on a mission to Discover, Explore, Loot, Infiltrate, Vanquish, Evolve, Recruit, Empower, Reign, and ultimately... Survive!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel® UHD Graphics 630 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 660 2GB / AMD Radeon™ HD 7850 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2000 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Integrated GPUs require additional 2GB of system RAM.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen™ 5 3600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 3GB / AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2000 MB available space
